newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo aluminium futures end higher for all months.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo aluminium futures end higher for all months.

text.p: Tokyo aluminium futures closed higher across the board on Thursday, reflecting stronger LME aluminium prices overnight, traders said.
TOCOM aluminium ended 0.4 to 2.1 yen higher, with the benchmark April 1998 contract up 1.5 yen at 210.2 yen per kg. The day's estimated volume was 3,990 lots.

Light buying orders from individual investors supported all of the contracts, traders said. The contracts fluctuated in a narrow range throughout the day, as local investors were sidelined due to the "Golden Week" holidays, they said. Trading is likely to remain quiet throughout this week, traders said.
